title: Office IT Equipment & Managed Support — FY27 Rollout
description: Procurement of laptops, endpoint management, and managed IT support for a 500-employee office expansion. (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)

requirements.text: Vendor must offer cloud hosting with API integration
Vendor must provide disaster recovery capability
Vendor must demonstrate GDPR data protection compliance
Vendor must disclose a delivery timeline under 30 business days
Vendor must disclose total contract pricing
Vendor must offer hardware warranty with on-site replacement
